paite: Huan Hannah athum a, hichi in achi, "Ka lungtang TOUPA tung ah akipak mahmah, TOUPA ah ka kii pahtawi in a-om. Ka melmate tung ah ka kam letsak in a-om; na hotdamna a ka kipah mahmah ziak in.
heading: Hannah Thumna

paite: TOUPA bang a siangthou a-om kei uh: Nang bang mahmah lah a-om ngal kei uh. I Pathian bang suangpi himhim leng a-om sam kei.
Huchi tel a kisathei in thu gen nawn kei unla; na kam ua pan pau uang himhim pawt kei hen. TOUPA lah pilna Pathian ahi ngal a, ama'n thilhihte hoihtak in abuk zel hi.
Mihat thalpeute akitansak a, akisuite taihatna a gak in a-om hi.
Niang leh tai a omte nek ding zong in alohtawm ua, gilkialte kial nawn lou uhi. Achiingnu'n ta sagih aneita a, ta tampi neinu abahta hi.
TOUPA'N athat a, ahingsak hi. Han ah apaisuksak a, apikhetou hi.
TOUPA'N azawngsak a, ahausasak a, ahihniam a, ahihsang hi.

Leivui a pan azawngte adingtousak a, ekvu a pan khutdohte adomtou hi. Miliante kiang a a-omsak theih a, thupina laltutphah atantheihna ding un. Lei kingaknate TOUPA a ahi a, ama'n atung uah khovel angata ngal a.
Amisiangthoute khe akem ding a, migiloute bel mial lak ah daihsak in a-om ding uh. Hatna a kuamah in zou lou ding ahi ngal a.
TOUPA melmate a i tamgawp ding ua, van a pan vanpiging bang in amaute adou ding. TOUPA'N kawlmong pha in vai ahawm ding a; akumpipa kiang ah hatna ape dia, athaunilhpa kii apahtawi ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Ramah ah a-inn ah Elkanah apaita hi. Huchi in naupang in siampu Eli ma ah TOUPA nna asemta hi.
Eli tapate Belial tapate ahi ua; TOUPA athei kei uh.
heading: Eli Tapate

paite: Mite lak a siampute hihdan ngeina ahihleh mi'n kithoihna ahong lat chiang un, sa huan laitak in siampu sikha sa thukna sikkhut zum thum nei tawi in ahong pai zel hi.

Belgongza hiam, belgong nei hiam, bel khaina nei hiam, bel hiam sung asunsuk a, huai sa thukna zum in ahon thukkhiak tengteng siampu in ala zel hi. Huchibang in Israel mi huai a hong pai tengteng a pan Shiloh ah ana hihsak zel uhi.
Huai ban ah, thau akhul ma un siampu sikha ahong pai a, kithoihmi kiang ah, "Siampu a ding haimin ding sa hon pia in. Na sa huanmin adeih kei, asial adeih hi," achi hi.

Mi'n akiang ah, "Athau pen khul phot uhenla, huai khit chiang in na hinna in adeih zahzah na la ding," ana chih chiang un ama'n, "Hilou e, tu mah a na hon piak pah ding ahi. N'on piak keileh thagum in ka la ding," achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA mitmuh in tangvalte khelhna athupi mahmah a, mite'n lah TOUPA kiang a kithoihna lat thilkihhuai in angaita uhi.
Himahleh Samuel in bel naupang chik in, puanmalngat siampu puanak silh in TOUPA ma ah nna asem hi.
heading: Shiloh Ah Samuel

paite: Huai lou leng anu'n puanaktual neu akhuisak a, kum teng kithoihna uh lan dia apasal toh ahoh chiang un kum teng in atawisak zel hi.
Eli in Elkanah leh azi avualzawl a, "TOUPA a dia na thillat uh mun luah ding numei suan TOUPA'N hon pia hen," achi hi. Huchi in a-inn uah apaita uhi.
TOUPA'N Hannah aveh a, nau apai a, tapa thum leh tanu nih anei hi. TOUPA ma ah naupang Samuel ahong khanglianta hi.
Eli bel atek mahmahta hi. Israel mi tengteng tung a atapate thilhih tengteng leh kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak bul a nasem numeite ana kithuahpih zel thute uh aza hi.
heading: Eli Leh Atapate

paite: Huchi in akiang uah, "Bangziak a hichibang thilhih na mai ua? Hiai mi tengteng a pan na thilhihdan hoihloute uh ka na za ngal a.
Hichi ding hilou ahi, ka tapate aw, na tanchin uh ka zak ahoih lou lam ngen ahi. TOUPA mite na taleksak uhi.

Mi khat, midang tung a akhelhleh Pathian in vai ahawmsak ding hi. Himahleh TOUPA tung a mi akhelhleh kua'n amah a ding in angetsakta dia?" achi hi. Huchi pipi in leng apa uh aw angaikhe kei ua, ToUPA'n amaute athah ding ziak in.
Naupang Samuel akhanglian deuhdeuh a; Pathian leh mihing deihsak in a-om hi.
Eli kiang ah Pathian mipa khat ahong a, akiang ah, "TOUPA'N hichi in achi, 'Aigupta gam a Pharaoh inn a na om lai un na pa inkote kiang ah ka kilak kei maw?
heading: Eli Inkuan Tungtang Genkholhna

paite: Israel nam tengteng lak a pan ka siampu hi ding, ka maitam a thil lan ding, gimlim hal ding leh siampu puanak silh dia amah ka tel ahi kei maw? Na pa inkote kiang ah Israel mite halmang thillat teng ka pia ahi kei maw?

Bangziak in ahia ka tenna a na lat ding ua ka thupiak ka kiang a kithoihna leh kei a tuam dia thillat pen lei toh sikden a, kei sang a na tapate na zahtak zawk a, noumau na kisukthauna ding ua ka mi Israelte kithoihna ahoihpente na zat uh?'

Huaiziak in TOUPA Israelte' Pathian in, 'Ke'n zaw na inkote leh na pa inkote tangtawn in ka ma ah na om ding uh,' ka na chi ngei hi. Himahleh tu in TOUPA'N, 'Na om het kei ding uh. Hon zahtak peuhmah ka zahtak dia, hon musit peuhmah ka musit ding,' achi hi.
Ngai in, 'na bante leh na pa inkote bante ka tankhiak ni ahong tung, na inn ah tekkun a dam a-om kei ding uh.
Ka tenna inn ah, Pathian in Israel hauhsakna apiak teng ah melma na mu dia, tangtawn in na inn ah tekkun a dam a-om kei ding uh.
Ka maitam a pan ka hihman louh ding na mi pen na mit hihkhamtu leh na lungsim lungkhamsaktu ahi ding. Na inn a hong piang peuhmah adawnsih zel ding uhi.
Hiai, na tapate nih Hophni leh Phinehas tung a thil tung ding nang a ding in chiamtehna ahi ding. Ni khat in anih un asi tuaktuak ding uhi.
Kei a ding in siampu muanhuai ka dingkhesak dia, huai in ka lungtang leh ka lungsim toh kituak in nna asem ding. Inkuan kiptak in ka lamsak dia, tangtawn in ka thaunilhmi ma ah a-om ding.

Huan hichi ahong hi ding a, na inn a om lai tengteng dangka leh tanghou ngen in akiang ah akuan ding ua, tanghou tawmchik bek nek ding ka muhtheihna ding un siampu nna khat bek hon semsak ve aw, chi in ka hong thum hi, achi ding uh," achi hi.
